note: On demand prices are fixed. Preemptible prices for H100, H200, B200, B300 and RTX PRO 6000 are dynamic spot prices that can change every 15 minutes and are not capped above the on demand rate. L40S is excluded from dynamic spot pricing and is billed at a flat preemptible rate. Spot prices differ per region, and a platform only publishes one when there is preemptible capacity for it, so an absent platform is a capacity signal rather than a missing price.

spot_snapshots.note: The same H100 spot price that was $0.79 at 04:11 UTC is $2.37 at 20:57 UTC, a factor of three inside one day. The breakeven against the fal.ai price moves from 2 assets per run to 6 over that window, with no change to the model, the code or the run.
